items.title: 10.11 Electrode potentials (ease of oxidation and reduction) (oxidation aur reduction kitni aasani se hoti hai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.11, printed pages 224-225.

blocks.text: Redox processes mein do aisi species ke darmiyan redox equilibrium hota hai jo chemical taur par juri hon magar different (alag alag) oxidation states mein hon. Jab kisi metal ko us ke apne ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to metal aur solution ke metal ions ke darmiyan ek electric potential (voltage) ban jata hai. Ise electrode potential kehte hain; yeh batata hai ke substance kitni aasani se oxidize ya reduce hota hai. Misal: copper ki rod ko us ke ions ke aqueous solution mein rakhein to yeh equilibrium qaim hota hai:
Is equilibrium mein do opposing (ek doosre ke ulat) reactions chal rahe hote hain:
a) Rod ke metal atoms ions ban kar solution mein jate hain aur electrons electrode ki surface (satah) par chhor jate hain.
b) Solution ke ions rod se electrons le kar electrode ki surface par metal atoms ki shakal mein jam jate hain.
Redox equilibrium us waqt qaim hota hai jab electrons lene ki rate electrons khone ki rate ke barabar ho jaye.
Copper jaise kam reactive (unreactive) metals mein, doosre metals ke muqable, equilibrium zyada right taraf hota hai:
Is liye Cu²⁺(aq) ions doosron ke muqable aasani se reduce hote hain; woh aasani se electrons le kar copper metal ban jate hain.
Vanadium jaise reactive metals mein equilibrium zyada left taraf hota hai:

Is liye V²⁺(aq) ions mushkil se reduce hote hain; woh doosron ke muqable bohat kam electrons lete hain. Apne ions ke solutions mein rakhe different metals ke liye equilibrium ki position different hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Apne ions ke solution mein metal
rows: aasan: Cu²⁺ aasani se electrons leta hai
mushkil: V²⁺ kam electrons leta hai

blocks.prompt: Reactive metal ki rod par electrons zyada kyun jama hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Reactive metal ke atoms aasani se ions ban kar solution mein chale jate hain (equilibrium left side), aur apne electrons rod par chhor jate hain. Is liye rod solution ke muqable zyada negative ho jati hai, aur us ka electrode potential zyada negative hota hai.

items: Electrode potential: metal aur us ke ions ke solution ke darmiyan voltage; oxidation ya reduction ki aasani batata hai.
Equilibrium Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Cu: electron lene aur dene ki rate barabar.
Copper: equilibrium right, Cu²⁺ aasani se reduce. Vanadium: left, V²⁺ mushkil se reduce.
